notes.title: Early access!
notes.content:
Hello! TRANSIT Early Access Launched!

This is not the end of the journey but another step forward. I want to add more content and features.

The next update will be released [b]today[/b]:

* Fix garage and car parts
* New territories
* New missions
* Survival mechanic
* Inventory
* Training

Thanks for support!
